depiction_rules.notes: A small group of distinct ordinary village boys accompanying toddler Krishna in D045 stanza 6.

visual_bible.age: young children near Krishna’s toddler age
visual_bible.skin: varied warm-brown mural pigment; no saturated orange
visual_bible.build: believable child proportions, ordinary two-arm and two-leg anatomy
visual_bible.clothing: simple muted cream, olive or maroon village cloth

continuity_markers: Two or three distinct young village boys, visually secondary to Krishna.
